text:
Morgan: Heads up — our structured-output rejection rate for tool calls spiked ~5x at 12:03 UTC after the routing policy change.
Sam: Saw the alert. Is this the policy that started preferring 'cheap-region' fallback when dedicated pool is saturated?
Anya: Yes, we flipped soft-fallback to prefer low-cost region for best-effort tier. That region uses a model variant without strict fncall tooling support.
Morgan: Exact symptom: tools returning top-level arrays and the strict validator rejects them. Lots of 422s from the adapter service.
Lina: Example from logs:
```
ERROR adapter-parse: validation failed: expected object at root, got array
request_id=abc123 route=/v1/tool/invoke model=redwood-lite
payload: ["status","ok"]
```
Sam: Oof. So routing sent requests to a model that serializes tool outputs differently. We should either coerce shapes or prevent routing to incompatible variants.
Anya: Can we detect capability mismatch earlier in routing? E.g., maintain a capability flag per model instance: supports_fncall=true|false, supports_structured_output=v1|v2
Morgan: We already have a per-model metadata table but it wasn't consulted by the fallback policy — fallback only considers latency/cost currently.
Lina: Quick mitigation: rollback the fallback policy and add a temporary shim in adapters that wraps array -> {result: array} for calls that include fn_call metadata.
Sam: Shim is fine short-term but dangerous for typed schemas. Some consumers expect top-level object keys.
Anya: For telemetry: we need a per-route breakdown in the Console that shows 'schema_rejects by model_variant' and a histogram of returned types (object/array/string). Right now Console only shows total fncall errors.
Morgan: Agreed — add a new panel: structured_output -> rejects_by_variant + sample payloads (P0 for devs). Also increase sampling for fncall failures to 100% for 1h so we can triage.
deploy-bot: canary_flag fallback_policy=cheap-region -> OFF by ops @ 12:10 UTC :white_check_mark:
schema-guardian: Recorded 240 samples during the minute window, pushing anonymized payloads to s3://redwood-debug/fncall/1889001234
Sam: Action items:
- Lina: roll adapter shim (short-term) and instrument coerces (risk note) — ETA 30m
- Anya: change routing policy to consult model capability table — ETA EOD
- Morgan: add Console panel request to product for P0 triage + enable enhanced sampling — ETA 2h for draft
- Ops: confirm rollback (thanks deploy-bot)
Anya: Also propose a longer-term: model onboarding pipeline should include a 'tooling_compat' tag and we run a quick fncall smoke test during capacity/variant registration.
Morgan: Good. Also let's add a pre-flight router check that simulates a minimal fncall to the target variant before routing the first real request (cache result for a short TTL).
Sam: I'll follow up in a ticket with logs and the s3 samples. If anyone sees further 422s ping me @sam :eyes:
Lina: On it. Will open the shim PR now and annotate with the risk matrix.
Morgan: Thanks all. Keep thread updated with any new 422 spikes.
